svg.title: Anatomy of a WebAgent
svg.desc: How one WebAgent wakes, reasons, proposes a tool call, passes the governed path, acts through a gateway, remembers and sleeps again.

g.font-family: Inter, 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
g.text: Anatomy of a WebAgent · one governed loop
A WebAgent is a durable kernel process running a HarnessAgent. It holds capabilities, never credentials, and sleeps for free between wakes.
role prompt · playbook skill · charter terms
allow · hold for the owner · deny
result to the model · loop or finish
a draft · a decision card · a signal
a reply · a receipt · then sleep
MEMORY · SCOPED TO THE WEBAGENT'S PARTITION AND SITE
A call outside the WebAgent's jobs is refused, a sleeping WebAgent holds no lease, and every effect runs once, through a gateway, with a receipt.
